text:
Had an annual check-up here to monitor my teeth and make sure they’re doing well 1 year ago. The dentist at the time wasn’t particularly friendly, but I don’t mind as long as they do a good job.

Despite specifically asking for only a checkup, they insisted on doing teeth cleaning too, which I had an appointment for at another dentist anyway. So I had to have this done and paid for it, despite not needing it.

After she finished looking around, I asked her to give me an update and tell me about my teeth health. She just responds ‘If there was anything wrong, I would tell you’, which was unnecessarily rude. Anyway, I just had another checkup a year on. I had to have one filling and they identified both sets of wisdom teeth (left and right) need to be taken out. They said due to the size of the infection in my wisdom teeth it has been around for about 2 years.

Maybe this dentist was having a bad day… but whoever it was, hopefully they can be more attentive to customers!
